issue.title: Resilient epic launches under concurrent bead-ID minting
issue.description: Approved epics launch successfully even when another machine or agent mints and publishes beads in the same store at the same time. ID collisions are relocated automatically, removed IDs are never minted again, a launch never reuses another plan's epic, and a graph that cannot be merged is re-minted from the plan instead of wedging the workspace store.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202611/resilient_epic_launch.md requests this work

issue.title: Published-ID collision rule in the sase-core stream merge
issue.description: merge: replace the raw issue_created count in the Rust three-way stream merge with a rule that relocates any unpublished creation of a published ID and accepts create/remove/create history, plus a Python resolver regression for the incident's stream shape.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/resilient_epic_launch.md defines phase merge as one work unit

issue.title: Advance next_counter past every relocation and stream ID
issue.description: counter: make the bead conflict resolver write config.json next_counter past every relocation ID and every stream ID in the store, even when config.json itself merged cleanly, so a rollback-and-retry never re-mints a relocated ID.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/resilient_epic_launch.md defines phase counter as one work unit

issue.title: Pre-mint store refresh and linked-epic identity check
issue.description: premint: integrate the remote bead store right before each epic-creation attempt (fail open on transient errors, fail early on conflicts), record the launch base commit, and treat a plan bead_id link whose epic belongs to a different plan as stale.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/resilient_epic_launch.md defines phase premint as one work unit

issue.title: Conflict replay for unmergeable zero-spawn graph publication
issue.description: replay: carry the integration status out of the managed sync worker, raise a typed publication-conflict error, and in the plan-launch retry loop discard the launch's own unpublished graph commit under a recovery ref and re-mint, with cause-first error text.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/resilient_epic_launch.md defines phase replay as one work unit

issue.title: Incident regression suite and docs
issue.description: regress: reproduce the full three-clone collision chain end to end with real git clones, assert the launch succeeds under fresh IDs, and update the bead-storage and epic-launch reference docs.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/resilient_epic_launch.md defines phase regress as one work unit

payload.entry: LAND TRIAGE (sase-1vt.land): No child phase recorded a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note. Plan out-of-scope 'Plans clone conflict': it recurred (14+ lumberjack-checks pulls of the bob-cli primary plans clone failed on 8304b5da 'Archive approved plan ctrl_jk_section_map', non-bead conflicts remain, latest 18:32:51). Filed as sase-1vu (bug, large, ready), linked related to sase-1vt, sase-n3, and sase-112. It was not caused by this epic. Plan out-of-scope 'Task-bead minting': declined, because it is a deliberate design boundary (task-bead create stays offline-fast) and not a defect. Also declined: cli_work_from_plan_launch.py grew to 894 lines, past the toobig 850 tier, which the toobig_split routine owns. ~105s artifact-link adds observed during landing are already tracked by sase-1vp and are unrelated to this epic. REMAINING EPIC WORK (caused by this epic), planned as a lander tale: (1) _cause_first_integration_error in src/sase/sdd/_repository_integration_repair.py labels every semantic-repair failure, including plans-store 'non-bead conflicts remain', as 'bead-ID collision with concurrently published history'. (2) _replay_publication_conflict skips the plan-required assert_bead_store_write_sandboxed guard before its hard reset. (3) The plan-file section of docs/reference/work-units/bead-work.md still says every publication failure preserves the checkpoint and omits the pre-mint refresh, the linked-epic identity check, and the replay, even though cli-workflows.md links to it. (4) Duplicate HEAD-SHA helper: premint _beads_repo_head_sha vs _sync_git.bead_store_head_sha.

Land verified: sase-core 7e857edd published-ID collision rule (pinned), counter floor past every stream/relocation ID, pre-mint refresh with transient/conflict policy plus linked-epic identity check, conflict replay with recovery ref, bounded attempts and refusal recovery, three-clone regression and docs. Landing tale fixed: neutral cause-first label for non-bead semantic failures, sandbox guard before the replay reset, bead-work.md plan-file behavior, single bead_store_head_sha helper. Integration since start (8c77e6fa64, 1b461588eb, f6dd22d4dd, sase-core 34461b7f) needed no changes. Follow-ups: sase-1vu filed; other proposals declined (see land triage note).
